+// newPathOptions resolves the default kubeconfig against SNAP_REAL_HOME when
+// running as a strictly confined snap, because snapd rewrites HOME to the
+// per-revision snap data directory, which kubectl never reads.
+func newPathOptions() *clientcmd.PathOptions {
+	pathOptions := clientcmd.NewDefaultPathOptions()
+	if realHome := os.Getenv(snapRealHomeEnvVar); realHome != "" {
+		pathOptions.GlobalFile = filepath.Join(realHome, clientcmd.RecommendedHomeDir, clientcmd.RecommendedFileName)
+		pathOptions.LoadingRules.MigrationRules = nil
+	}
+	return pathOptions
+}
+
+// client-go formats kubeconfig read errors with %v, so errors.Is cannot see
+// the underlying permission error and the message has to be matched instead.
+func withSnapPermissionHint(err error, kubeconfigFiles []string) error {
+	realHome := os.Getenv(snapRealHomeEnvVar)
+	if realHome == "" || len(kubeconfigFiles) == 0 || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), fs.ErrPermission.Error()) {
+		return err
+	}
+	// The kube-config plug only grants access to ~/.kube, so connecting it can't fix other paths.
+	kubeDir := filepath.Join(realHome, clientcmd.RecommendedHomeDir)
+	for _, file := range kubeconfigFiles {
+		rel, relErr := filepath.Rel(kubeDir, file)
+		if relErr != nil || !filepath.IsLocal(rel) {
+			return err
+		}
+	}
+	return fmt.Errorf("%w\nTo allow the glab snap to access ~/.kube, run: sudo snap connect glab:kube-config", err)
+}

+func TestAgentUpdateKubeconfig_Snap_WritesToRealHome(t *testing.T) {

+	require.NoError(t, err)

+}

+func TestAgentUpdateKubeconfig_PermissionDenied(t *testing.T) {
+	if os.Geteuid() == 0 {
+		t.Skip("root ignores file permissions")
+	}
+
+	unwritableDir := func(t *testing.T, dir string) string {
+		t.Helper()
+		require.NoError(t, os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o700))
+		require.NoError(t, os.Chmod(dir, 0o500))
+		t.Cleanup(func() { _ = os.Chmod(dir, 0o700) })
+		return filepath.Join(dir, "config")
+	}
+	unreadableFile := func(t *testing.T, dir string) string {
+		t.Helper()
+		require.NoError(t, os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o700))
+		path := filepath.Join(dir, "config")
+		require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, nil, 0o000))
+		return path
+	}
+	realKubeDir := func(realHome string) string { return filepath.Join(realHome, ".kube") }
+	otherDir := func(string) string { return "" }
+
+	tests := []struct {
+		name string
+		// dir picks where the kubeconfig lives from SNAP_REAL_HOME; "" means a temporary directory.
+		dir         func(realHome string) string
+		kubeconfig  func(t *testing.T, dir string) string
+		snap        bool
+		defaultPath bool
+		viaFlag     bool
+		wantHint    bool
+	}{
+		{name: "snap write to default path shows connect hint", dir: realKubeDir, kubeconfig: unwritableDir, snap: true, defaultPath: true, wantHint: true},
+		{name: "snap read under ~/.kube shows connect hint", dir: realKubeDir, kubeconfig: unreadableFile, snap: true, wantHint: true},
+		{name: "snap write outside ~/.kube returns plain error", dir: otherDir, kubeconfig: unwritableDir, snap: true, wantHint: false},
+		{name: "snap read of --kubeconfig outside ~/.kube returns plain error", dir: otherDir, kubeconfig: unreadableFile, snap: true, viaFlag: true, wantHint: false},
+		{name: "non-snap write returns plain error", dir: otherDir, kubeconfig: unwritableDir, snap: false, wantHint: false},
+		{name: "non-snap read returns plain error", dir: otherDir, kubeconfig: unreadableFile, snap: false, wantHint: false},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			realHome := t.TempDir()
+			if tt.snap {
+				t.Setenv("SNAP_REAL_HOME", realHome)
+			} else {
+				t.Setenv("SNAP_REAL_HOME", "")
+			}
+			dir := tt.dir(realHome)
+			if dir == "" {
+				dir = t.TempDir()
+			}
+			kubeconfig := tt.kubeconfig(t, dir)
+			args := "--agent 42"
+			switch {
+			case tt.defaultPath:
+				t.Setenv("KUBECONFIG", "")
+			case tt.viaFlag:
+				t.Setenv("KUBECONFIG", "")
+				args += " --kubeconfig " + kubeconfig
+			default:
+				t.Setenv("KUBECONFIG", kubeconfig)
+			}
+			exec := setupUpdateKubeconfigCmd(t)
+
+			_, err := exec(args)
+
+			require.ErrorContains(t, err, "permission denied")
+			if tt.wantHint {
+				assert.ErrorContains(t, err, "sudo snap connect glab:kube-config")
+			} else {
+				assert.NotContains(t, err.Error(), "snap connect")
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}

+}
